verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Smithery sandbox or test environment that isolates testing from production data. Uplink lets a developer test an unpublished MCP server against a real agent, but that is pre-publish testing, not an isolated sandbox. Scoped service tokens and namespaces are adjacent access-control and workspace features, not a documented sandbox mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
